question: **Select the most appropriate option for blank no. 9. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **crops**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Grains **are the seeds of wheat, rice, etc.
 
• **Crops **are plants that are grown on farms for food.
 
• **Flowers **are the coloured part of a plant or tree from which seeds or fruit grow.
 
• **Seeds **are the small hard part of a plant from which a new plant of the same kind can grow.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words 'crops' is the most appropriate word.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: "**These swarms are destroying harvested plants, which is destroying the entire agricultural industry****.**"

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 Complete Passage: *The locust is an insect that belongs to the family of grasshoppers. These insects are essentially harmless (1) unless__ they meet certain circumstances under which they __(2) become__ more abundant and change their behaviour. India, Pakistan and Iran (__3) are__ currently thinking over the locust plague threat __(4) lingering__ over their economies. When these locusts meet __(5) suitable__ environmental conditions, they become gregarious and __(6) start __breeding abundantly. With their population becoming (7) __denser____,__ they form swarms and keep moving __(8) across__ areas damaging the crops. These swarms attacking **__(9) crops__** and thereby devastating the entire agricultural economy is (10)______ is commonly referred to as locust plague. *
